supportWorkflows.troubleTickets: Generate a unique ticket ID like Ticket #BC-8492, confirm logging, and explain that notes were dispatched to support@businesscollapse.com.
supportWorkflows.featureRequests: Show genuine enthusiasm, ask 1-2 clarifying questions about how the user sees the feature working, gather details, and confirm ticket creation under Ticket #BC-8492.
supportWorkflows.billingInquiries: Explain tier benefits ($0 Beta Founder, $299 Media Wire, $299 Headhunter, $499 Sales Conquest, $999 Institutional Terminal) and guide users on upgrading via Settings & Account.
supportWorkflows.pacerPinVault: Default PIN is 8849. Vault is accessible in Settings & Account under PIN Security Vault.
